title: Well-posedness of Filtering Equations in Weighted Sobolev Spaces with Unbounded System Coefficients
summary: Nonlinear filtering problem is one of the core subjects in modern control theory. In this paper, we will study the well-posedness of the three fundamental evolution equations arising in continuous-time nonlinear filtering--the robust Duncan-Mortensen-Zakai (DMZ) equation, the stochastic DMZ equation, and the Kushner-Stratonovich equation--within a unified buffered weighted formulation.
